<!-- Tip: If the app fails to start or behaves unexpectedly, running with
--verbose prints system diagnostics that help identify the problem:

  UsageMonitorForClaude.exe --verbose

or from source:

  python -m usage_monitor_for_claude --verbose

To collect the output as a file, redirect both streams.

In cmd.exe:

  UsageMonitorForClaude.exe --verbose > log.txt 2>&1

In PowerShell (the default in Windows Terminal), run the same command
through cmd.exe - a plain redirect leaves the file empty there:

  cmd /c "UsageMonitorForClaude.exe --verbose > log.txt 2>&1"

The command returns once you quit the app from the tray menu. The file
fills while the app runs, even though Explorer shows 0 KB until then.

Paste the output below if you can - it saves a lot of back and forth. -->
